name: Daily Zen Wallpaper
author: modpunk (omarchy.fans)
description: Turn a long-form YouTube mood stream (lofi, zen, ambient) into your Omarchy wallpaper: animated with sound, or a fresh still every day. A library of the ten most popular streams per category, creators to follow, bookmarks and star ratings shared across installs. One click asks Aether to build an Omarchy theme from the current scene.

barWidget.description: Zen chip: play or pause the stream wallpaper, mute it, grab a still, or make an Aether theme from the scene.

schema.label: Tell me when a new version is published
